title: SteelSeries Aerox 3 Wireless Gaming Mouse

comparisons.notes: Aerox 3 Wireless 2022 Edition, model 62608, same MPN; lowest offer from a marketplace seller.
Mfr part 62608, UPC 850014119522 exact match; can be shipped.

writeup: The SteelSeries Aerox 3 Wireless is a 68g ultralight gaming mouse with a perforated shell, dual 2.4GHz and Bluetooth connectivity, and up to 200 hours of battery life. Woot has it for $29.99, while Newegg sellers ask $73.89 and Micro Center lists it at $109.99. Condition wasn't confirmed on the offer page, and Woot limits it to one per customer.
